name: Obholzhof
beschreibung: The Obholzhof is located on the edge of Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser, surrounded by meadows and alpine pastures. The inn is rustically furnished and radiates a relaxed atmosphere. Guests can expect regional dishes and typical Tiroler cuisine, served in a cozy dining room with wooden furniture. The terrace offers views of the surrounding mountains. Suitable for hikers and families looking for simple, rustic accommodation in the Wilden Kaiser.
